def policy(piles):
    c = sum(1 for p in piles if p > 1)
    ones_indices = [i for i, p in enumerate(piles) if p == 1]
    k = len(ones_indices)
    
    if c == 0:
        # All are 0 or 1
        non_zero = [i for i, p in enumerate(piles) if p > 0]
        if len(non_zero) % 2 == 1:
            # Losing, take any
            i = non_zero[0]
            return f"{i},1"
        else:
            # Winning, take 1
            i = non_zero[0]
            return f"{i},1"
    elif c == 1:
        # Find the large pile
        large_idx = -1
        large_val = 0
        for i, p in enumerate(piles):
            if p > 1:
                large_idx = i
                large_val = p
                break
        # k is already count of 1s
        if k % 2 == 1:
            # Take all
            return f"{large_idx},{large_val}"
        else:
            # Take all but 1
            return f"{large_idx},{large_val - 1}"
    else:
        # c >= 2
        s = 0
        for p in piles:
            s ^= p
        if s == 0:
            # Losing
            for i, p in enumerate(piles):
                if p > 0:
                    return f"{i},1"
        else:
            # Find winning move
            for i, p in enumerate(piles):
                target = p ^ s
                if target < p:
                    return f"{i},{p - target}"
            # Should not reach here if s != 0
            for i, p in enumerate(piles):
                if p > 0:
                    return f"{i},1"
